description: A sixteen harmonic additive oscillator driven by a phase patched into it rather than by a pitch of its own

params.text: Damps the higher harmonics on a falling curve, 0 to 10; at 0 the strengths at Pts are used as they come
Shifts where in the cycle the wave starts, 0 to 1 of a turn

inputs.text: The phase the wave is read at; a clean saw wave over -5V to 5V gives one cycle of the wave for each cycle of the saw
Sets the strength of each harmonic, one channel per harmonic counting up from the fundamental, 10V for full strength; with nothing patched only the fundamental sounds
Sets the damping by voltage in place of the Dmp knob, 0-10V across none to full, and moves the knob while it is patched

outputs.text: The wave, with every harmonic added at its own strength

notes: nothing sounds until a phase is patched into Phs; the module has no oscillator of its own, and its pitch is the pitch of whatever drives it
menu: block dc — takes the constant offset out of the output, which is worth doing when the harmonics leave the wave off centre

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the fundamental alone.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Dmp knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
